title: Organisers hoping for 'joyful' demonstration as French public workers strike
summary: France braced for another day of protests Tuesday as unions called for a nationwide strike by public sector workers in a bid to secure pay rises. Hoping to avoid the violence that has marred recent protests in the country, organisers were hoping for a "joyous and festive" occasion, reports France 24's Claire Paccalin from a march in Paris.
